en.headline: ICAC charges Kai Tak Hospital site team leader over bribes from workers
en.dek: A 52-year-old subcontractor team leader faces 10 counts of accepting advantages totalling HK$75,100 from five imported electrical workers.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴啟德醫院建築項目分判商工頭涉收賄
zh.dek: 52歲分判商工頭面對10項代理人接受利益控罪，涉向五名輸入電工收取共75,100元。

en.headline: LegCo passes Northern Metropolis Development Bill to accelerate project
en.dek: Lawmakers unanimously approved the dedicated legislation on Thursday after two days of debate, with the Development Bureau saying it will streamline planning and land procedures.

zh.headline: 立法會三讀通過北部都會區發展條例草案 加快項目推進
zh.dek: 議員經過兩日辯論後於周四一致通過這項專屬法例，發展局表示將有助簡化規劃及地政程序。

en.headline: Five property owners fined over HK$320,000 for ignoring removal orders
en.dek: The Buildings Department said the convictions at Sha Tin and West Kowloon courts involved unauthorised walls, rooftop structures and other works.

zh.headline: 五名業主未遵清拆令共罰逾32萬元
zh.dek: 屋宇署表示，沙田及西九龍裁判法院裁定的案件涉及僭建護土牆、天台搭建物及其他工程。

en.headline: Design at HKG runs Peak sensory installation until 24 November
en.dek: The Hong Kong Design Centre's programme includes a free multi-sensory installation at the Peak and other citywide events through late November.

zh.headline: 設計@HKG山頂多感官裝置展至11月24日
zh.dek: 香港設計中心主辦的活動包括山頂免費多感官裝置，以及全城其他設計項目，主要活動期至本月下旬。

en.headline: Three sports events receive M Mark status for November and December
en.dek: The Major Sports Events Committee awarded recognition to the Hong Kong Open badminton, FIBA 3x3 basketball and Hong Kong Squash Open.

zh.headline: 三項體育盛事獲頒M品牌認可 涵蓋羽球籃球壁球
zh.dek: 大型體育活動事務委員會向香港公開羽毛球錦標賽、FIBA 3x3世界巡迴賽及香港壁球公開賽授予認可。

en.headline: Education Amendment Bill to be gazetted tomorrow with teacher practice certificate rules
en.dek: The bill will require teachers at all schools to hold a practice certificate lasting up to three years and introduce safeguards for national security convictions.

zh.headline: 《2026年教育（修訂）條例草案》明日刊憲 引入教師執業證明書
zh.dek: 草案規定所有學校教師須持有有效期不超逾三個學年的執業證明書，並設立機制處理干犯國安罪行人士的註冊事宜。

en.headline: Transport Department urges Kai Tak concertgoers to use railway and avoid illegal hire cars
en.dek: Officials reminded spectators at the coming Kai Tak Stadium shows to plan their departure by MTR and warned that illegal cross-boundary hire cars may lack valid insurance.

zh.headline: 運輸署呼籲啟德演唱會觀眾乘搭鐵路 避免乘坐非法過境出租車
zh.dek: 運輸署提醒即將在啟德主場館舉行的演唱會觀眾，散場時應乘搭港鐵，並警告非法過境出租車的第三者保險可能無效。

en.headline: Hong Kong Tourism Board runs Gourmet Month with more than 400 restaurants through November
en.dek: The campaign offers limited-time menus and late-night deals at hundreds of outlets after the Wine and Dine Festival, including Michelin-starred venues.

zh.headline: 旅發局推出香港美食月 逾400間食肆至月底提供限定菜單
zh.dek: 活動在美酒佳餚巡禮後舉行，涵蓋米芝蓮星級餐廳至地區食肆，並設深夜飲食指南，部分商戶延長營業時間。

en.headline: John Lee officiates at ceremony for 160th anniversary of Sun Yat-sen birth
en.dek: The government held the official commemoration at Sun Yat Sen Memorial Park this morning, with senior officials and central government representatives in attendance.

zh.headline: 李家超主禮孫中山先生誕辰160周年紀念儀式
zh.dek: 政府今早在中山紀念公園舉行官方紀念儀式，行政長官李家超主持並致辭，多名高層官員及中央駐港機構代表出席。

en.headline: Customs seize over a tonne of smuggled frozen meat and food from Chung Ying Street route
en.dek: Nine people were arrested after officers intercepted vans carrying roughly 570 kg of frozen meat and 500 kg of other food believed to have entered via Sha Tau Kok.

zh.headline: 海關破中英街走私凍肉案 檢逾噸貨拘9人
zh.dek: 海關截查貨車，檢獲約570公斤凍肉及500公斤其他食品，相信經沙頭角中英街入境後分銷至街市及住宅，9人被捕。

en.headline: Oil Street Art Space opens free Luofu exhibition with new works by three artists
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department exhibition reinterprets the historic mountain through painting, calligraphy and interactive installations, open from 11 November at 12 Oil Street.

zh.headline: 油街實現免費新展「羅浮香影」 三名本地藝術家重新演繹羅浮山
zh.dek: 康文署主辦展覽由11月11日起在北角油街12號油街玻璃屋展出，作品涵蓋書法、屏風及互動裝置。

en.headline: 72-year-old garage owner dies after car falls on him in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: Police said the man was crushed under a private car he was repairing when the jack apparently failed at a workshop in Sheung Tsuen on Wednesday afternoon.

zh.headline: 將軍澳上村72歲車房東主遭私家車壓死
zh.dek: 警方表示，事主周三下午在穎禮路戶外修車場維修自己的私家車時，千斤頂疑故障，被車壓住送院後不治。

en.headline: Police arrest 29-year-old man for slapping Tsim Sha Tsui taxi driver
en.dek: Officers detained the suspect in Wong Tai Sin on Wednesday afternoon on suspicion of common assault after a dispute over an automatic door early Tuesday.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕29歲男子 涉掌摑尖沙咀的士司機
zh.dek: 警方周三下午在黃大仙區以涉嫌普通襲擊拘捕姓梁男子，案件源於周二凌晨因自動車門爭執。

en.headline: Driver flees after police stop BMW in Wong Tai Sin; 90 etomidate capsules seized
en.dek: Traffic officers pursued the white car after it failed to give way at a zebra crossing; the driver abandoned the vehicle and escaped, police said.

zh.headline: 黃大仙寶馬拒停司機逃去 警檢90粒依托咪酯
zh.dek: 交通警因車輛在斑馬線未讓路而追截，司機棄車逃走，警方其後在車上檢獲懷疑毒品。

en.headline: Woman dies after collapsing in Happy Valley flat, boyfriend reports
en.dek: Police said the 47-year-old was found unconscious by her boyfriend at a unit on Leighton Road late on Wednesday evening and later died in hospital.

zh.headline: 跑馬地47歲女子單位暈倒送院不治
zh.dek: 警方表示，事主的男友周三晚上發現她在禮頓道單位內暈倒，送院後證實不治。

en.headline: Police arrest 31 in Yau Tsim raid targeting illegal workers and vice
en.dek: Officers and Immigration Department staff searched multiple locations in the district on Wednesday under operation CHAMPION, detaining people suspected of overstaying and illegal employment.

zh.headline: 油尖區打擊黑工及掃黃行動拘31人
zh.dek: 油尖警區聯同入境處周三在區內展開代號「冠軍」行動，突擊搜查多處，拘捕涉嫌逾期居留及非法勞工的人士。

en.headline: Five passengers suffer minor injuries after airport apron shuttle brakes suddenly
en.dek: A shuttle bus carrying travellers from the apron to the passenger terminal at Hong Kong International Airport made an abrupt stop late on Wednesday evening.

zh.headline: 機場停機坪穿梭巴士疑急煞 五人輕傷送院
zh.dek: 香港國際機場一輛接載旅客由停機坪前往客運大樓的穿梭巴士周三晚上突然煞停，五名乘客受傷。

en.headline: Wan Chai Sikh temple lights up in blue for Bandi Chhor Divas until 24 November
en.dek: Khalsa Diwan Sikh Temple on Queen's Road East is illuminated nightly with cascading blue lights to mark the festival, drawing residents and photographers.

zh.headline: 灣仔錫克教廟亮起藍燈慶祝囚徒解放日 至11月24日
zh.dek: 位於皇后大道東的Khalsa Diwan錫克教廟每晚以藍色燈飾點亮外牆，慶祝Bandi Chhor Divas及排燈節，吸引市民及攝影愛好者到場。

en.headline: 21-year-old man found dead in Tai Hang flat after being discovered hanging
en.dek: Police said the mainland tenant was found by the flat owner on Wednesday evening at a unit on Sun Chun Street; a note was recovered at the scene.

zh.headline: 大坑21歲內地男子單位內上吊亡 業主揭發
zh.dek: 警方表示，事主為持雙程證來港的張姓男子，周三晚上約九時五十分被業主在新村街39號單位發現，現場檢獲遺書。

en.headline: Education Bureau urges school to strengthen values education after vaping video
en.dek: The bureau contacted Po Leung Kuk Yao Ling Sun College in Tsuen Wan after a video of students in uniform appeared to show vaping inside a toilet cubicle.

zh.headline: 教育局促荃灣中學加強價值教育 因應學生疑在校內吸電子煙影片
zh.dek: 教育局聯絡保良局耀靈中學，因一段顯示身穿校服學生在廁格內疑吸食電子煙的影片在網上流傳。

en.headline: Arts in the Park returns to Causeway Bay with fairy-tale parades this weekend
en.dek: The free outdoor youth arts festival organised by the Hong Kong Youth Arts Foundation runs on 14 and 15 November, featuring giant puppets and night and finale parades.

zh.headline: 藝術在公園本周末重臨銅鑼灣 童話主題遊行登場
zh.dek: 香港青年藝術協會舉辦的免費戶外青年藝術節於11月14及15日舉行，設巨型木偶及夜間與壓軸遊行。

en.headline: Hong Kong Observatory cancels Red Fire Danger Warning
en.dek: The Observatory lifted the Red Fire Danger Warning late on Wednesday after it had been in force since early Monday, with the fire risk no longer extreme.

zh.headline: 天文台取消紅色火災危險警告
zh.dek: 天文台周三深夜取消自周一起生效的紅色火災危險警告，火災危險性已不再處於極高程度。

en.headline: Organisers cancel Mega Fans Expo after Japanese performers denied entry
en.dek: The three-day adult entertainment event at the Regal Airport Hotel and a preview scheduled for Thursday have been called off, with refunds to follow.

zh.headline: 近30名日本女優疑遭拒入境 Mega Fans Expo主辦方宣佈取消
zh.dek: 原定富豪機場酒店舉行的三日成人展及周四預覽活動取消，主辦方稍後公布退款安排。

en.headline: Centre for Health Protection investigates new mpox case in 26-year-old man
en.dek: The patient developed a rash and fever and reported high-risk sexual contact in Hong Kong with men met through social media platforms.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查26歲男子確診猴痘個案
zh.dek: 患者出現皮疹及發燒，潛伏期內曾與透過社交平台結識的男子有高風險性接觸。

en.headline: Police arrest 22 after dismantling cross-border money laundering syndicate
en.dek: The two-day Thundernet operation seized more than 1,600 bank cards, HK$5.85 million in cash and over 200 phones linked to more than HK$150 million laundered.

zh.headline: 警方「雷網」行動搗破跨境洗黑錢集團 拘捕22人
zh.dek: 兩日行動檢獲逾1600張銀行提款卡、約585萬元現金及逾200部手機，集團8至10月疑清洗逾1.5億元。

en.headline: Centre for Food Safety suspends poultry imports from more areas in Korea and the…
en.dek: The centre acted after notifications of highly pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks in Jangheung-gun, Yeoju and Gelderland.

zh.headline: 食安中心暫停進口韓國及荷蘭更多地區禽肉及禽蛋
zh.dek: 中心因應長興郡、驪州及海爾德蘭省爆發高致病性禽流感而採取行動。

en.headline: Centre for Food Safety finds colony count over limit in Meadows milk sample
en.dek: The affected batch of Australian UHT skimmed milk remains in the importer's warehouse and has not entered the market.

zh.headline: 食安中心抽查Meadows脫脂奶菌落超標 產品未流出市面
zh.dek: 受影響批次的澳洲超高溫處理脫脂奶仍存於進口商貨倉，沒有流入市場。

en.headline: 72-year-old garage owner dies after car falls on him in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: Police said the man was trapped under a private car he was repairing in Upper Village and later died in hospital.

zh.headline: 將軍澳上村七旬車房東主修車遭壓 送院不治
zh.dek: 警方表示，事主在上村維修私家車期間遭車壓着，送院後不治。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes down 241 points as tech shares slide
en.dek: The benchmark fell 0.98 per cent to 24,315.92, with the Hang Seng Tech Index down 1.41 per cent amid pressure from higher US inflation expectations.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收市跌241點 科技股拖累
zh.dek: 恒指全日跌0.98%報24315.92點，恒生科技指數跌1.41%，市場受美國通脹數據高於預期影響。

en.headline: Hong Kong ranks 11th globally in digital and AI competitiveness
en.dek: The city placed fourth in Asia in the IMD World Digital and AI Ranking 2026, with top rankings in workforce development, efficiency and several sub-factors.

zh.headline: 香港數碼及人工智能競爭力全球排名第11
zh.dek: 國際管理發展學院公布的2026年世界數碼及人工智能排名中，香港在70個經濟體中排第11，亞洲第4，多項因素及子因素表現突出。

en.headline: Hong Kong opens International Academy of Policing to train local and overseas officers
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee said the academy will train about 1,000 officers each year, including 200 from overseas, through programmes and leadership forums.

zh.headline: 香港國際警務學院正式成立 每年培訓約千名警務人員
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超主持開幕典禮，學院目標每年培訓約1000名警務人員，當中包括約200名海外執法人員。

en.headline: Festival Walk opens Pokémon 30th anniversary event with first Hong Kong Pokémon Center…
en.dek: The free celebration runs from 11 November to 3 January at the Kowloon Tong mall, featuring installations, a time tunnel and the first official Pokémon Center pop-up store in the city.

zh.headline: 又一城Pokémon 30周年活動開幕 全港首個Pokémon Center Pop-Up登場
zh.dek: 免費活動由11月11日至明年1月3日在九龍塘又一城舉行，設巨型裝置、時光隧道及全港首個官方Pokémon Center限時店。

en.headline: Cathay Group orders 14 more Airbus aircraft for fleet expansion
en.dek: The order covers 11 A330-900s and three A321neos, bringing planned new deliveries from 2026 to 120 and total investment commitments above HK$150 billion.

zh.headline: 國泰集團再訂購14架空中巴士飛機擴充機隊
zh.dek: 新訂單包括11架A330-900及3架A321neo，使2026年起新飛機交付總數達120架，十年投資承諾超過1500億元。

en.headline: Government to gazette sexual offences amendment bill on Friday
en.dek: The Security Bureau said the bill will modernise Hong Kong’s laws and strengthen victim protection, with first and second readings set for 25 November.

zh.headline: 政府周五刊憲性罪行修訂條例草案
zh.dek: 保安局表示草案將現代化香港性罪行法例並加強受害人保護，11月25日提交立法會首讀及二讀。

en.headline: URA receives three tenders for final To Kwa Wan redevelopment plot
en.dek: CK Asset, China Overseas Land & Investment and a Sino Land-Great Eagle consortium submitted bids for the To Kwa Wan Road/Wing Kwong Street project after the noon deadline.

zh.headline: 市建局土瓜灣道／榮光街項目截收三份標書
zh.dek: 長實、中海外及信和與鷹君合組財團在周三中午截標時入標，該項目為土瓜灣小區重建最後一個地盤。

en.headline: Li Ka-shing funds Asia-first non-invasive kidney tumour trials in Hong Kong
en.dek: The Li Ka Shing Foundation is funding 30 places at three private hospitals for histotripsy clinical trials treating kidney cancer without surgical incisions.

zh.headline: 李嘉誠資助組織碎化技術腎癌臨床試驗 香港成亞洲首個城市
zh.dek: 李嘉誠基金會向三間私家醫院提供合共30個名額，以組織碎化技術（Histotripsy）進行腎臟癌無創治療臨床試驗。

en.headline: Happy Wednesday Music and Dine Festival returns to Happy Valley tonight
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club’s themed race night at Happy Valley Racecourse features live music, special drinks and food from 6pm, with public enclosure entry at HK$10.

zh.headline: 跑馬地Happy Wednesday音樂美食節今晚舉行
zh.dek: 香港賽馬會跑馬地馬場主題賽馬夜今晚六時開始，啤酒園有現場音樂、特色飲品及美食，公眾席入場費10元。

en.headline: Buildings Department finds One Stanley steel work does not match approved plans
en.dek: Development Secretary Bernadette Linn said the investigation is largely complete and the department will consult the Justice Department on possible prosecution.

zh.headline: 屋宇署指赤柱ONE STANLEY鋼筋配置與圖則不符 將徵詢律政司檢控意見
zh.dek: 發展局局長甯漢豪表示調查大致完成，署方已勒令抽查屋苑其他單位，並計劃要求承建商灌注混凝土前拍照或錄像記錄鋼筋。

en.headline: Firefighters put out Mong Kok flat fire linked to charger, several people treated
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a Mong Kok flat fire linked to a charger within half an hour, with more than twenty residents evacuated and several people feeling unwell from smoke.

zh.headline: 旺角新填地街單位疑充電器起火 消防灌救多人疏散
zh.dek: 旺角永福大廈一住宅單位今早七時許疑充電器短路冒煙起火，消防半小時內將火救熄，約二十五人自行疏散，數人包括嬰兒感到不適。

en.headline: Man dies after being pulled from the sea at Western Harbourfront
en.dek: A man in his forties was found floating near the piers opposite the Western Wholesale Food Market early Wednesday and later died in hospital, police said.

zh.headline: 西環海濱長廊男子墮海 送院搶救不治
zh.dek: 一名年約四十歲南亞裔男子今早在西區副食品批發市場對開海面被發現載浮載沉，獲救後送瑪麗醫院，惜不治。

en.headline: Government and MTR sign Northern Link agreement as cost falls to HK$86.2 billion
en.dek: The full main and spur lines are targeted to open by 2034 after the Executive Council approved the second-phase financial arrangements, 28 per cent below earlier estimates.

zh.headline: 政府與港鐵簽署北環線全線協議 建造成本降至862億元
zh.dek: 行政長官會同行政會議批准第二部分財務安排後，主線及支線目標於2034年或之前同步開通，整體造價較原先估計低28%。

en.headline: Police investigate Sai Kung burglary after watches and earrings worth HK$245,000 stolen
en.dek: A 62-year-old woman reported the theft from her flat on Tuesday night; the case has been classified as burglary with no arrests so far.

zh.headline: 西貢住宅爆竊 失約24.5萬元手錶及耳環
zh.dek: 62歲姓陳女子周二晚報案指北港坳路單位有財物失竊，警方初步點算兩隻手錶及一對耳環共值約24.5萬元，案件列作爆竊，暫未有人被捕。

en.headline: Worker injured after falling from truck while unloading goods in Sheung Shui
en.dek: A 52-year-old man was taken conscious to North District Hospital after falling about one metre from a medium-sized truck early on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 上水工人搬貨時從貨車墮下受傷
zh.dek: 52歲姓楊男子周三凌晨約2時在安樂門街從中型貨車墮下約一米，清醒送往北區醫院治理，案件列作工業意外。

en.headline: Police say two rescued from sea at Hung Hom waterfront after drinking
en.dek: Firefighters pulled a man and a woman from the water early Wednesday after they entered the sea during an argument; both were unharmed and refused hospital treatment.

zh.headline: 警方指紅磹海濱長廊兩男女飲酒後墮海獲救
zh.dek: 消防凌晨將一男一女救回上岸，兩人清醒無傷，拒絕送院，警方初步調查無可疑。

en.headline: 55th Hong Kong French Film Festival opens today at City Hall
en.dek: The Alliance Française event runs until 9 December with more than 50 films across eight venues, opening with Antonin Baudry’s two-part De Gaulle.

zh.headline: 第55屆香港法國電影節今日於大會堂開幕
zh.dek: 由香港法國文化協會主辦，活動至12月9日，於八個場地放映逾50部電影，開幕片為安托南·博德里的《戴高樂》。

en.headline: Red Fire Danger Warning remains in force as temperatures dip overnight
en.dek: The Observatory said the warning issued on Monday continues with extreme fire risk while urban readings hovered around 18 degrees early Wednesday and some New Territories spots fell lower.

zh.headline: 紅色火災危險警告持續 今早市區約18度新界更低
zh.dek: 天文台指警告自周一發出後仍然生效，火災危險性極高；今早市區約18度，新界部分地區輻射冷卻降至約11度。

en.headline: Standard Chartered Arts in the Park returns to Causeway Bay this weekend with…
en.dek: The free outdoor youth arts festival runs 14-15 November at Victoria Park, featuring illuminated night and grand finale parades with giant puppets.

zh.headline: 渣打藝趣嘉年華本周末重臨銅鑼灣 童話主題巨型木偶巡遊免費開放
zh.dek: 活動於11月14至15日在維多利亞公園舉行，夜光巡遊及壓軸巡遊將有巨型木偶帶領青年表演者遊行。

en.headline: Motionless rat filmed lying on the floor inside Tai Wo Plaza in Tai Po
en.dek: A video shared in a local Facebook group on Tuesday showed a rat lying still with its eyes open as shoppers walked past, drawing comments about the mall's hygiene.

zh.headline: 大埔太和廣場老鼠躺地一動不動 途人淡定走過
zh.dek: 周二有網民在Facebook群組上載影片，顯示一隻老鼠躺在太和廣場地面，雙目打開，女學生拍攝期間其他途人照常經過。

en.headline: AFCD captures several nuisance monkeys near Cross Harbour Tunnel bus interchange
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said dedicated teams caught multiple aggressive monkeys that had been snatching food and items from people over the past two weeks.

zh.headline: 漁護署在城門隧道轉車站及郝德傑道捕捉多隻滋事猴子
zh.dek: 漁農自然護理署表示過去兩星期專責隊伍成功捕獲多隻具攻擊性、經常搶奪市民食物及物品的猴子，並增設大型捕捉籠。

en.headline: Design@HKG opens two-week citywide programme with Peak bubble installation
en.dek: Hong Kong Design Centre's rebranded flagship runs until 24 November with more than 40 free and ticketed activations, including a multi-sensory inflatable at Peak Galleria.

zh.headline: 設計@HKG揭幕 山頂吹氣裝置免費開放至11月24日
zh.dek: 香港設計中心旗艦活動一連兩周於全港舉行逾40項設計項目，山頂廣場多感官裝置毋須預約免費入場。

en.headline: Police hunt 38-year-old man after kitchen-knife assault at Tuen Mun NOVO LAND
en.dek: A 23-year-old woman sustained a forehead wound and leg bruises in an alleged attack by her partner early on Tuesday; officers seized a 20cm knife and classified the case as assault occasioning actual bodily harm.

zh.headline: 屯門NOVO LAND廚刀襲擊案 警方追緝38歲男子
zh.dek: 23歲女子前額有約2厘米刀傷及腳部瘀傷，案件列作襲擊致造成身體傷害，屯門警區刑事調查隊第一隊跟進，暫未有人被捕。

en.headline: AFCD captures two unchipped mongrels on Cheung Chau after resident complaints
en.dek: The dogs were found unsupervised near Tung Tai San Tsuen and Cheung Kwai Estate on Monday and taken to an animal management centre for observation.

zh.headline: 漁護署在長洲捕捉兩隻無晶片無人看管唐狗
zh.dek: 署方周一在東堤新邨及長貴邨一帶展開特別行動，兩隻唐狗已送往動物管理中心觀察。

en.headline: Alibaba chip unit T-Head files confidential application for Hong Kong IPO
en.dek: The company said T-Head submitted a Form A1 application on 11 September after the stock exchange cleared the proposed spin-off, with deal size still undecided.

zh.headline: 阿里巴巴晶片單位平頭哥提交香港上市機密申請
zh.dek: 公司表示平頭哥於九月十一日提交A1表格申請，港交所已批准分拆，集資規模仍未敲定。

en.headline: Centre for Food Safety suspends poultry imports from North Lincolnshire in UK
en.dek: The move follows a World Organisation for Animal Health notification of highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza in the area, with the suspension taking immediate effect.

zh.headline: 食安中心暫停英國林肯郡北林肯郡禽肉及禽類產品進口
zh.dek: 措施因應世界動物衞生組織通報當地爆發高致病性H5N1禽流感而即時生效，以保障本港公眾健康。

en.headline: PolyU students open speculative furniture exhibition on Hong Kong’s future in Tsim Sha…
en.dek: Henceforth… Hong Kong… runs free at The Grid in Heath Mall from 10 to 24 November, with nine pieces exploring density, ageing and resources over the next 50 years.

zh.headline: 理大設計學生尖沙咀展出構想未來香港的家具作品
zh.dek: 「今後香港」展覽即日起至十一月二十四日在希慎道商場The Grid免費舉行，九件作品探討未來五十年密度、人口老化與資源問題。

en.headline: Red Fire Danger Warning remains in force with extreme fire risk
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the warning, issued at 6.10am on Monday, continues as relative humidity stays low and conditions remain dry.

zh.headline: 紅色火災危險警告仍然生效 火災危險性極高
zh.dek: 天文台指警告自周一上午六時十分發出後持續，相對濕度偏低，天氣乾燥。

en.headline: Labour chief says 7300 construction sites inspected under smoking ban, 84 fixed…
en.dek: Sun Yuk-han said most of the inspections since the July 17 ban were surprise checks and that contractors faced five summonses over failure to take reasonable steps.

zh.headline: 孫玉菡稱地盤禁煙後巡查7300個工地 發出84張定額罰款
zh.dek: 勞工及福利局局長表示大部分為突擊檢查，並向承建商發出五張告票，涉四宗未採取合理步驟個案。

en.headline: HKMA proposes lower capital charges for loans to Northern Metropolis university towns
en.dek: The authority plans to designate 11 post-secondary institutions and three park companies as domestic public sector entities, with legislative amendments targeted for early next year.

zh.headline: 金管局擬修訂資本規則 降低北都大學城貸款資金成本
zh.dek: 當局建議將11間專上院校及三間園區公司指定為本地公營單位，修訂案擬於2027年第一季提交立法會，第二季生效。

en.headline: Worker injured after forklift falls from platform at Kwai Chung logistics centre
en.dek: A 65-year-old man remained conscious after the vehicle and he fell about 1.3 metres at a Hutchison facility; police are investigating.

zh.headline: 葵涌物流中心男工連人帶叉車墮載貨台 頭部受傷送院
zh.dek: 65歲男工人於貨櫃碼頭南路和黃物流中心駕駛叉車時連人帶車由約1.3米高平台墮下，一度被困，清醒送瑪嘉烈醫院，警方調查中。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes up 108 points at 24557 as financial and AI stocks gain
en.dek: The benchmark rose 0.44 per cent on Tuesday, with HSBC climbing more than 4 per cent while the Hang Seng Tech Index gained 1.08 per cent.

zh.headline: 港股高收108點報24557 金融及AI股造好滙控升逾4%
zh.dek: 恒生指數周二升0.44%，滙控升逾百分之四，恒生科技指數升1.08%。

en.headline: Government and MTR sign full Northern Link project agreement with construction cost at…
en.dek: The Chief Executive in Council approved the financial arrangement for Part 2 on Tuesday, bringing the entire project 28 per cent below the original estimate and targeting opening by 2034.

zh.headline: 政府與港鐵簽訂北環線全線項目協議 建造成本預算總計862億
zh.dek: 行政長官會同行政會議周二批准第二部分財務安排，整個項目建造成本較原先估算減少兩成八，目標二〇三四年或之前開通。

en.headline: Contractors fined up to HK$155,000 over fatal Yuen Long village house demolition accident
en.dek: The Labour Department prosecuted three parties after a female worker was killed when a brick wall collapsed during clearance work in November last year.

zh.headline: 元朗拆卸村屋致命意外 工程公司及承建商被罰13萬至15.5萬
zh.dek: 勞工處就去年十一月一名女工在人手清理工作時遭磚牆倒塌壓斃事件提出檢控，粉嶺裁判法院周二判罰三方。

en.headline: Symphony of Lights to end after 22 years with final show on 18 November
en.dek: The Hong Kong Tourism Board said the last performance will include a fireworks element on the evening the WinterFest begins, with other light projects to follow next year.

zh.headline: 幻彩詠香江22年歷史將於11月18日作最後一場演出
zh.dek: 旅發局主席林建岳表示，最後一場會加插煙火元素，當晚亦是繽紛冬日巡禮揭幕日，其他光影項目明年推出。

en.headline: Police arrest 44-year-old minibus driver over suspected drug driving with passengers
en.dek: Officers stopped a route 117B minibus in Sau Mau Ping after a tailing operation; the driver tested positive for methamphetamine and seven passengers were removed safely.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕44歲小巴司機涉載客時毒後駕駛
zh.dek: 人員尾隨一輛117B專線小巴至秀茂坪截停，司機口腔液測試呈冰毒陽性，車上7名乘客被安全帶離。

en.headline: New mortgage insurance approvals and drawdowns hit multi-year lows in October
en.dek: The Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation recorded 701 new approvals in October, the lowest in nearly 11 years, while new drawdowns fell more than 40 per cent.

zh.headline: 十月新批按保及新取用按保宗數創逾十年新低
zh.dek: 按揭證券公司數字顯示，十月新批按保701宗，近十一年最低；新取用按保宗數及金額大跌逾四成。

en.headline: Special traffic arrangements for Victoria Harbour Race in Wan Chai and Tsim Sha Tsui
en.dek: The Transport Department said Expo Drive East will close on Sunday and several ferry and water taxi services will be suspended from Saturday to support the November 15 race.

zh.headline: 維港泳周日舉行 灣仔北及尖沙咀實施特別交通安排
zh.dek: 運輸署表示，金紫荊廣場外一段博覽道東周日臨時封閉，多條渡輪及水上的士航線周六日起暫停服務。

en.headline: Civil servants to receive 12 hours of family care leave a year from January
en.dek: The Civil Service Bureau detailed the new entitlement in a paper to the Legislative Council panel, allowing flexible hourly leave for family matters with streamlined approval.

zh.headline: 公務員明年一月起每年可享12小時照顧家庭假
zh.dek: 公務員事務局向立法會事務委員會提交文件，詳細說明新假期安排，容許靈活按小時計假處理家庭事務，申請程序簡化。

en.headline: Paragliding association open to compulsory registration after self-taught pilot injures…
en.dek: The Hong Kong China Paragliding Association said it supports real-name registration if it improves safety, after a pilot known to lack formal training struck three hikers at Ma On Shan on Sunday.

zh.headline: 滑翔傘協會支持強制登記 自學飛手撞傷行山人士後
zh.dek: 中國香港滑翔傘總會表示，若有助提升安全，樂見強制實名登記；周日一名已知缺乏正式訓練的飛手在馬鞍山昂平撞傷三名行山人士。

en.headline: Observatory cancels Strong Monsoon Signal after morning winds ease
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the Strong Monsoon Signal at 11:45am on Tuesday, while the Red Fire Danger Warning remains in force with extreme fire risk.

zh.headline: 天文台上午11時45分取消強烈季候風信號
zh.dek: 天文台周二上午11時45分取消強烈季候風信號，紅色火災危險警告仍然生效，火災危險性極高。

en.headline: Police investigate criminal damage after red liquid thrown in Tsuen Wan claw machine shop
en.dek: Two black-clad men entered a claw machine shop on Hoi On Street early on Tuesday and splashed red liquid on machines, the floor and walls before fleeing, police said.

zh.headline: 荃灣夾公仔店遭淋紅色液體 警方列刑事毀壞跟進
zh.dek: 周二凌晨兩名黑衣男子進入享和街夾公仔店，向機台、地面及牆壁淋潑紅色液體後逃去，警方正在調查。

en.headline: Officials step up rodent control at Tsim Sha Tsui Cultural Centre after night videos
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said it received five complaints in two weeks and placed traps after footage showed groups of rats on the viewing platform.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀文化中心夜間現鼠群 康文署加強滅鼠
zh.dek: 康文署表示過去兩周接獲五宗投訴，並在網上影片顯示觀景台有鼠群後放置捕鼠器。

en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal and Red Fire Danger Warning remain in force
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said northerly winds continued, with extreme fire risk and temperatures recovering after a 17.5-degree low.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號及紅色火災危險警告持續生效
zh.dek: 天文台表示偏北強風持續，火災危險極高，清晨最低十七點五度後氣溫回升。

en.headline: Japanese artist Yasuhito Kawasaki shows miniature ceramics at Tai Kwun
en.dek: The exhibition of gentle paintings and palm-sized ceramic sculptures runs at Touch Gallery in Block 3 until 28 November.

zh.headline: 日本藝術家川崎康仁大館觸摸藝廊展出微型陶瓷
zh.dek: 展覽以溫柔繪畫及掌上陶瓷雕塑為主，在大館第三座觸摸藝廊展至十一月二十八日。

en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal remains in force with northerly gusts to 72 km/h
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the signal continues, with Cheung Chau recording 52 km/h sustained winds and 72 km/h gusts in the hour to 7.30am.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號持續 長洲陣風達每小時72公里
zh.dek: 天文台表示信號仍然生效，今早七時半前一小時長洲錄得持續風速52公里、陣風72公里。

en.headline: Harris Ho wins Hong Kong's first Youth Olympics individual fencing gold
en.dek: The 17-year-old foil specialist beat Japan's Masashi Maeda 15-8 in the Dakar final, giving the city its second gold of the Games and its first individual fencing title at the Youth Olympics.

zh.headline: 何承謙摘青奧男子花劍金牌 香港劍擊首個人金
zh.dek: 17歲何承謙在達喀爾決賽以十五比八擊敗日本前田將志，為香港摘下青奧第二金，亦是香港劍擊青奧首個人金牌。

en.headline: Observatory records 17.8 degrees, lowest of the autumn so far
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the temperature at its headquarters fell to 17.8 degrees at 5.30am on Tuesday, with the Strong Monsoon Signal and Red Fire Danger Warning still in force.

zh.headline: 天文台清晨錄得十七點八度 入秋以來最低
zh.dek: 天文台表示周二清晨五時半總部氣溫降至十七點八度，強烈季候風信號及紅色火災危險警告仍然生效。

en.headline: MUJI marks 25 years in Hong Kong with free exhibition at Man Yee Building
en.dek: The exhibition runs until 29 November in the first-floor atrium of the Central mall, featuring a large Ferris-wheel installation and a reaction game for app members.

zh.headline: 無印良品香港二十五周年 中環萬宜大廈免費展覽至十一月二十九日
zh.dek: 「原點．源於 無印良品」展覽在中環萬宜大廈商場一樓中庭舉行，設巨型摩天輪裝置，會員可參與反應遊戲。

en.headline: Two men injured, one unconscious, after taxi hits them in Yau Ma Tei
en.dek: Police said a taxi turning from Shanghai Street into Pak Hoi Street struck two men outside a barbecue restaurant early on Monday; both were taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital.

zh.headline: 油麻地的士轉灣撞倒兩男子 一人昏迷送院
zh.dek: 警方表示，週一清晨約十二時半，一輛的士由上海街轉入北海街時撞倒兩名男子，其中一人昏迷，兩人送伊利沙伯醫院。

en.headline: Police arrest 38-year-old over Ferrari F40 near-miss with Citybus in Repulse Bay
en.dek: A local man was arrested on Monday on suspicion of dangerous driving after a classic Ferrari F40 pulled out from a side road into the path of a Citybus on Saturday evening.

zh.headline: 淺水灣法拉利F40險撞城巴 38歲司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 警方周一在香港仔拘捕一名38歲本地男子，涉嫌與周六晚上淺水灣道一宗法拉利F40未讓路險撞城巴事件有關。

en.headline: Man dies after collapsing while hiking on Tai Mo Shan
en.dek: Police and firefighters responded after a man reported chest pain on Tai Mo Shan on Monday; he was airlifted to hospital but pronounced dead.

zh.headline: 男子大帽山行山胸口痛昏迷 送院後不治
zh.dek: 周一中午一名男子在大帽山行山時胸口痛，政府飛行服務隊直升機將他送院，最終不治。

en.headline: Woman injured after folding table falls from Cheung Sha Wan building
en.dek: Police arrested a 33-year-old man on suspicion of allowing an object to fall after a table dropped onto a car and grazed a 32-year-old woman’s hand on Monday evening.

zh.headline: 長沙灣大廈摺檯墮下傷女子 33歲男子涉容許物件墮下被捕
zh.dek: 警方表示，周一傍晚一張摺檯從長沙灣長順街工廈墮下，撞及私家車並擦傷32歲女子手部，一名33歲男子已被捕。

en.headline: Observatory keeps Strong Monsoon Signal in force as temperatures fall toward 16 degrees
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said strong northerly winds continued under the signal issued Monday morning, with urban lows around 16 degrees expected Tuesday and a Red Fire Danger Warning still active.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號持續生效 氣溫將降至約16度
zh.dek: 天文台表示，周一清晨發出的強烈季候風信號仍然生效，預料偏北強風持續，周二早上市區最低約16度，紅色火災危險警告亦維持。

en.headline: Bad & Breakfast greasy-spoon cafe to open on Wing Lok Street in Sheung Wan
en.dek: The outlet, a sequel to a Yau Ma Tei bar, will serve full English breakfast sets from HK$58 and cocktails at night starting this week.

zh.headline: 上環永樂街將開英式早餐咖啡店Bad & Breakfast
zh.dek: 油麻地酒吧延續項目本周開業，全日英式早餐套餐由58元起，晚間供應雞尾酒。

en.headline: Bar Association tells High Court tribunal erred in clearing Margaret Ng
en.dek: Senior counsel argued the disciplinary panel overlooked the likelihood that Ng’s 2019 unlawful assembly conviction brought the profession into disrepute.

zh.headline: 大律師公會向高院指紀律審裁組錯判吳霧儀無失當
zh.dek: 資深大律師陳詞指審裁組忽略吳霧儀2019年非法集結定罪可能令專業蒙羞。

en.headline: MTR issues non-compliance notice over Tung Chung West station columns
en.dek: The operator said it issued the notice on Monday after about 30 columns were found substandard and is awaiting a remedial proposal from contractors.

zh.headline: 港鐵向東涌西站承建商發出不合規通知
zh.dek: 港鐵表示周一就約30條欠妥支柱向承建商發出通知，正等候全面報告及補救方案。

en.headline: Legco resumes second reading of Northern Metropolis Development Bill on Wednesday
en.dek: The bills committee finished scrutiny after 12 meetings and about 30 hours, and the bill could complete passage this week if supported.

zh.headline: 立法會周三恢復二讀《北部都會區發展條例草案》
zh.dek: 法案委員會完成約30小時審議，若獲支持，本周內可完成三讀程序。

en.headline: Five sentenced in ICAC probe of 400 million yen investment fraud
en.dek: District Court sentenced three defendants today to between 33 and 54 months; ICAC is seeking three more foreign suspects in the case involving fake Standard Chartered documents.

zh.headline: 廉署揭4億日圓投資詐騙案 五人判囚最高54個月 另通緝三人
zh.dek: 區域法院今日判處三名被告介乎33至54個月監禁；廉署正通緝另外三名外籍涉案人士，案件涉及偽造渣打銀行文件。

en.headline: John Lee meets AFC president and outlines five-year sports strategy
en.dek: The Chief Executive told Shaikh Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa that Hong Kong would strengthen support for team sports and seek more top international football events with Kai Tak Sports Park.

zh.headline: 李家超會晤亞洲足協會長 介紹五年規劃體育策略
zh.dek: 行政長官向Shaikh Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa表示，政府將加強隊際運動支援，並期待藉助啟德體育園帶來更多頂級國際足球盛事。

en.headline: TDC expects more than 3,000 at Business of IP Asia Forum
en.dek: The two-day event at the Convention and Exhibition Centre on 19 and 20 November will focus on IP commercialisation and run alongside Entrepreneur Day with over 370 startups.

zh.headline: 貿發局預期亞洲知識產權營商論壇逾3000人參與
zh.dek: 兩日活動將於11月19及20日在灣仔會議展覽中心舉行，聚焦知識產權商業化，並與創業日同步，後者有逾370間初創企業。

en.headline: Ocean Park Tower halts mid-air, stranding about 40 visitors
en.dek: A mechanical fault stopped the observation cabin at about 3.30pm on Monday; one visitor felt unwell and was brought down by firefighters, with no injuries reported.

zh.headline: 海洋公園摩天塔機件故障 約40人一度被困半空
zh.dek: 星期一約下午3時半觀光塔停於半空，一名遊客感到不適由消防人員游繩帶離，暫未有人受傷。

en.headline: Digital Policy Office opens applications for robot community pilot
en.dek: Eligible groups may borrow the humanoid Smart Bot free of charge for public events between 15 December and 28 February; the deadline is noon on 20 November.

zh.headline: 數字辦「機器人走入社區」試驗計劃接受申請
zh.dek: 合資格機構可免費借用人形機器人「友智寶」參與12月15日至2月28日的免費社區活動，截止時間為11月20日正午。

en.headline: EMSD finds 720 Tai Zoom lifts missing door-frame parts
en.dek: Director Pang Kwok-ying said about 90 per cent of the contractor’s installations lacked required components; remedial work on two estates is due mid-month and private buildings within two to three months.

zh.headline: 機電署發現臺日720部升降機未裝門框組件
zh.dek: 潘國英指佔該公司安裝總數約九成；兩個租置屋邨執修要求本月中完成，私樓預計兩至三個月內完成。

en.headline: Hang Seng closes down 33 points at 24449
en.dek: The index ended at 24,449 after trading between 24,437 and 24,733, edging lower from Friday's close of 24,482.

zh.headline: 恆指收市跌33點報24449
zh.dek: 指數全日高見24733、低見24437，最終收報24449點，較上日收市24482點微跌。

en.headline: Legco to require research for non-binding motions from next year
en.dek: Legislative Council President Starry Lee said lawmakers must submit research findings and recommendations when raising motions without legislative effect, to make debates more evidence-based.

zh.headline: 立法會明年起非立法效力議案須附研究
zh.dek: 立法會主席李慧瓊表示，議員提出無立法效力的議案時須提交研究結果及建議，讓政府及公眾更易理解意圖，促進以證據為本的討論。

en.headline: Police arrest Citybus driver after pedestrian dies in North Point
en.dek: A man was struck by a Citybus at about 8am on King's Road near Tin Chong Street; he was pronounced dead at Eastern Hospital at 8.54am and the driver has been arrested.

zh.headline: 北角城巴撞倒途人致死 司機被捕
zh.dek: 今早約8時，一名男子在北角英皇道近電廠街遭城巴撞倒，送東區醫院後於8時54分證實死亡，城巴司機已被捕。
